verses.pali: “Saparikkamano ayaṁ, bhikkhave, dhammo, nāyaṁ dhammo aparikkamano.
verses.english: “Mendicants, this teaching provides a bypass, it doesn’t lack a bypass.

verses.pali: Kathañca, bhikkhave, saparikkamano ayaṁ dhammo, nāyaṁ dhammo aparikkamano?
verses.english: And how does this teaching provide a bypass, not lacking a bypass?

verses.pali: Pāṇātipātissa, bhikkhave, pāṇātipātā veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Not killing living creatures bypasses killing living creatures.

verses.pali: Adinnādāyissa, bhikkhave, adinnādānā veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
Kāmesumicchācārissa, bhikkhave, kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Avoiding sexual misconduct bypasses sexual misconduct.

verses.pali: Musāvādissa, bhikkhave, musāvādā veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
Pisuṇavācassa, bhikkhave, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
Pharusavācassa, bhikkhave, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Avoiding harsh speech bypasses harsh speech.

verses.pali: Samphappalāpissa, bhikkhave, samphappalāpā veramaṇī parikkamanaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Avoiding talking nonsense bypasses talking nonsense.

verses.pali: Evaṁ kho, bhikkhave, saparikkamano ayaṁ dhammo, nāyaṁ dhammo aparikkamano”ti.
verses.english: That’s how this teaching provides a bypass, it doesn’t lack a bypass.”
